name: Thalassian Pass holding cell (second door)
region: Inside the Thalassian Pass post, end of the cell passage

sensoryProfile.sight: A room barely wider than the door ('a room the size of a wardrobe'); hard white-blue ward-lamp light; the lamp hangs behind a standing Sylvanas so her shadow covers the prisoner; empty iron pegs
sensoryProfile.sound: Lamp hissing overhead; the wall stone humming low and even (to Jaina a flat hand on her chest, cutting each breath she draws toward her magic); rangers breathing at the door; a cup set down in the guardroom. When the wedge is pulled the hum drops and the whole current-field floods in like surf.
sensoryProfile.smell: Horse, cold air, crushed fern when Sylvanas steps close
sensoryProfile.touch: Stone cold; the wall stone hums through the chair and skull
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Confinement used as pressure; silence held until someone breaks it; for Jaina it is also a muffler on the thing she came to find

establishedFacts.fact: Furnishings: one wooden chair, a bucket, iron pegs jutting at shoulder height right of the door (empty; for staff, cloak and belt if a prisoner were allowed them).
A loaf-sized ward-stone is set in the wall behind the chair at seated head height; grey, gold runes, humming. Jaina frowns at it twice.
The door is barred from outside; the bar lifts and the door swings inward.
Cyndia stays at the threshold; rangers draw back from the doorway as Sylvanas enters and stops in front of the chair.

Low in the wall behind the chair back, below the big ward-stone, a smaller wedge-shaped stone sits in a notch cut to fit, one rune on its face picked out in gold. Jaina felt it against her spine all day without seeing it. Cyndia pulled it free: the hum drops, the 'hand' comes off Jaina's chest, and the full noise of the currents (and the contamination's sour drag, muffled by the rings) arrives. This is a deliberate muffler for mages held in the cell.

Jaina sat in this chair from before dawn (taken off the stone at first light) through the noon bowl until night; she left the bowl uneaten. The cell stone carries the same late drag in each pulse that she heard at the split-cap stone, but she dismissed it as her own pulse and no sleep.

eventsHere.event: First face-to-face between Sylvanas and Jaina; chapter 1 ends on 'Start talking.'
Jaina gives the short version, confesses nobody sent her, answers questions on the map; Sylvanas sets terms; Cyndia pulls the damper wedge and the party leaves.
